steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0004 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (medium confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0004-SOURCE_MISMATCH-faca5bff]
  - 3.5% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (35 of 1005) [ref S2-B0004-CURRENT_WITHOUT_PAYMENT-2e056945]

Due: 2026-09-14 · Requires approval before it is carried out.

DRAFT LETTER — Schedule a field exam with screen-level source review
To: Borrower B0004, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0004)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0004-SOURCE_MISMATCH-faca5bff]
  - 3.5% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (35 of 1005) [ref S2-B0004-CURRENT_WITHOUT_PAYMENT-2e056945]

Please provide access, within the audit rights of the credit agreement, to the servicing system so our examiners can review the listed loans on screen by 2026-09-18.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
